How Prop Firms Work in 2025

Prop firms work by letting traders prove themselves on an evaluation account before giving them access to larger simulated capital. The model has grown quickly since 2020.

Step one: the evaluation

You pay a fee, receive an evaluation account, and must reach a profit target without breaching the daily loss or overall drawdown rules. Most traders fail on the drawdown rule rather than the profit target.

Step two: the funded account

After passing, you trade a funded account and request payouts on a schedule. The profit split determines how much of each payout is yours.

Step three: scaling

Consistent traders can scale to larger accounts. Scaling plans vary between firms and are worth reading before you choose one.
